verdict.rationale: RUN's package docs say new employees can fill out their own paperwork electronically before their first day, covering personal info, direct deposit and Form W-4 (adp-run-docs-26). They also say Form I-9 can be completed electronically during new-hire onboarding (adp-run-docs-29). Together these cover all three requested data sets in a self-serve pre-day-one flow. Missing for 10: detail on how the ops user sends or invites the new hire into the flow, clarity on which package tier includes these features, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond one-line marketing claims.
